item.title: CamWallet v2: A Closed Ledger With No Bank in the Path
item.description: How CamWallet’s second version changed two assumptions, who decides eligibility and where payment happens, and why everything else in the design follows from those two changes.

item.title: CamWallet: What Two Retrospectives Taught Me About Building With an Agent Loop
item.description: CamWallet’s v2 epics were built with an unattended AI agent loop. Two retrospectives showed the same pattern each time: the loop built too much, a human review cut it back, and the history recorded both.
